an9.43:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso kāyasakkhi vutto bhagavatāti.
an9.43:2.1: idhāvuso bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.43:2.2: yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phusitvā viharati
an9.43:2.3: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso kāyasakkhi vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena.
an9.43:3.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyajjhānaṃ
an9.43:3.4: yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phusitvā viharati
an9.43:3.5: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso kāyasakkhi vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena.
an9.43:4.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.43:4.2: yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phusitvā viharati
an9.43:4.3: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso kāyasakkhi vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena …pe…
an9.43:5.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati paññāyapassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti
an9.43:5.2: yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phusitvā viharati
an9.43:5.3: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso kāyasakkhi vutto bhagavatā nippariyāyenāti. 44
